import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    G = np.tanh(params[9]*t)
    return (params[0]*G + params[1]*P*t + params[2]*P**2 + params[3]*P**2*t + params[4]*P
            + params[5]*P*G + params[6]*P**2*G + params[7]*P**3*G + params[8]*t*(G-1))
